baseFrontend: validated Admin 7 runtime with truthful EMS overview, in-grid edit controls, short-name password API and release cache invalidation
label: v100
notes: Automatic updates are enabled by default only for installed NexoWatt adapters that have a stable repository entry.
The implementation configures ioBroker native adapterAutoUpgrade policies; EOS does not run an independent package installer.
The Admin/Service user can disable the feature in the EOS cockpit and previous repository/adapter policies are restored.
Third-party adapter upgrade policies remain untouched.
The browser release watcher and cache-safe runtime from 7.9.99 remain active.
changes: Added a NexoWatt Stable auto-update manager with repository and installed-adapter detection.
Added an admin-only cockpit toggle and status card.
Added native GET/POST endpoints for update status and enable/disable settings.
Added policy snapshot/restore so disabling reverts only changes owned by EOS.
Added a six-hour reconciliation and repository refresh through the ioBroker host.
